steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: Send a client a receipt for what they have paid so far. Start on Clients.

steps.caption: The invoice
steps.narration: Under Invoices, find the invoice. This one is part paid, with a balance still due.

steps.caption: The receipt to date
steps.narration: This is the receipt to date: the invoice, and every payment received on it.

steps.caption: Paid and owing
steps.narration: At the bottom are the total paid, and the balance still owing.

steps.caption: Emailed
steps.narration: It is emailed to the address on the client's file.

steps.caption: Payment receipts
steps.narration: With Payment receipts switched on, a receipt also goes out by email when a payment is recorded.

steps.caption: Where to find it
steps.narration: The Receipt button is on the client's page, under Clients in the left menu.

youtube.title: How to send a client a receipt | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: Open the receipt for a paid or part-paid invoice in ConstructHUB CRM, check the payments received and the balance owing, and email it to your client. Also shows the setting that sends a receipt when a payment is recorded. Recorded in a demo workspace.
